sources.title: Quaresma e Solenidades da Semana Santa de Braga

method: Read four direct Matriz PCI inventory HTML documents, paraphrase distinct actions, rituals, documented historical change and region-specific subactions; source locator is HTML extracted line (not original archival folio). Records are nested components under four broader research themes. Some Braga and Entre-os-Rios actions share Easter devotion as typological related practices, not single historical local custom. Alenquer Epiphany family wall marking combines Catholic narratives, house inscriptions and local social symbolism; not every mark is ecclesiastical approval. The women’s singing record is broad non-Christian as well as local religious cultural heritage; only Lenten souls prayer / parish worship portions should qualify for candidate Catholic customs. Bracarense local rite remains separate from 1962 Roman liturgy. No automatic merges or ritual rubrics appropriated.
